description: Download a human-readable markdown report for an EdgeGate run and save it to disk. Returns the absolute file path plus a preview of the first 30 lines. Optionally includes a run-vs-baseline diff section (include_diff=true).

include_diff.description: When true, also fetches the run-vs-baseline diff and appends a diff section to the report.

output_path.description: Where to write the markdown file. Defaults to `./edgegate-run-{id-short}.md` in the current working directory. If a directory, the file is named `edgegate-run-{id-short}.md` inside it. Supports `~` and relative paths.

name: edgegate_export_run_report
